details.question: Average MAB and MEB by GL description for retail accounts.
details.sql: SELECT gldesc, ROUND(AVG(mab_bal),2) AS avg_mab, ROUND(AVG(meb_bal),2) AS avg_meb FROM workspace.default.mab_meb WHERE retail_bulk = 'RETAIL' GROUP BY gldesc ORDER BY gldesc

details.question: How many accounts are there per product type? Show highest first.
details.sql: SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY accounts DESC, product_type

details.question: How many closed accounts are there per product type?
details.sql: SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS closed_accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE account_close_date <> '-' GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY closed_accounts DESC, product_type

details.question: For active, NRI customers, show number of accounts and total MAB by product type, highest MAB first.
details.sql: SELECT p.product_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(SUM(m.mab_bal),2) AS total_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.dormancy_status = 'A' AND p.nri_status = 'Y' GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY total_mab DESC

details.question: List the top 10 open accounts where MAB is more than twice MEB.
details.sql: SELECT p.full_name, p.source_account_nbr, m.mab_bal, m.meb_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' AND m.mab_bal > 2 * m.meb_bal ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: How many accounts have a service segment different from the income segment? Break down by pair.
details.sql: SELECT service_segment, income_segment, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE service_segment <> income_segment GROUP BY service_segment, income_segment ORDER BY accounts DESC, service_segment, income_segment

details.question: Total MAB by employee code for open, active accounts, highest first.
details.sql: SELECT m.EMP_CODE, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(SUM(m.mab_bal),2) AS total_mab, ROUND(AVG(m.mab_bal),2) AS avg_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' AND p.dormancy_status = 'A' GROUP BY m.EMP_CODE ORDER BY total_mab DESC

details.question: Count accounts by dormancy status and NRI status.
details.sql: SELECT dormancy_status, nri_status, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY dormancy_status, nri_status ORDER BY dormancy_status, nri_status

details.question: How many accounts were opened in each year? Show the latest year first.
details.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4) ORDER BY yr DESC

details.question: Show total MAB and MEB by final segment for retail accounts.
details.sql: SELECT final_segment, ROUND(SUM(mab_bal),2) AS total_mab, ROUND(SUM(meb_bal),2) AS total_meb FROM workspace.default.mab_meb WHERE retail_bulk = 'RETAIL' GROUP BY final_segment ORDER BY total_mab DESC

details.question: List open accounts with a card block code of FRZ along with their MAB.
details.sql: SELECT p.full_name, p.source_account_nbr, p.card_block_code, m.mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' AND p.card_block_code = 'FRZ' ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 15

details.question: How many accounts per scheme type are held by a MAIN HOLDER?
details.sql: SELECT schm_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE acc_holder = 'MAIN HOLDER' GROUP BY schm_type ORDER BY accounts DESC, schm_type

details.question: How many accounts have a linked user id, and how many do not?
details.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN linked_userid IS NULL THEN 'Not linked' ELSE 'Linked' END AS link_status, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY CASE WHEN linked_userid IS NULL THEN 'Not linked' ELSE 'Linked' END ORDER BY link_status

details.question: What is the total original FD amount by FD bucket?
details.sql: SELECT fd_bucket, COUNT(orig_fdamt) AS fd_accounts, ROUND(SUM(orig_fdamt),2) AS total_orig_fd FROM workspace.default.mab_meb WHERE orig_fdamt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fd_bucket ORDER BY total_orig_fd DESC

details.question: Show the number of branches (brcode) per GL code and the total MAB for each.
details.sql: SELECT glcode, COUNT(DISTINCT brcode) AS branches, ROUND(SUM(mab_bal),2) AS total_mab FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY glcode ORDER BY glcode

details.question: List the 10 accounts with the highest MAB that are closed.
details.sql: SELECT p.source_account_nbr, p.full_name, p.product_type, p.account_close_date, m.mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date <> '-' ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Average MAB for NRI vs non-NRI customers, by product type.
details.sql: SELECT p.product_type, p.nri_status, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(AVG(m.mab_bal),2) AS avg_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY p.product_type, p.nri_status ORDER BY p.product_type, p.nri_status

details.question: How many open accounts per source system code?
details.sql: SELECT source_system_code, COUNT(*) AS open_accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE account_close_date = '-' GROUP BY source_system_code ORDER BY source_system_code

details.question: Show accounts where MEB is greater than MAB for savings (SA) product, top 10 by the difference.
details.sql: SELECT p.source_account_nbr, p.full_name, m.mab_bal, m.meb_bal, ROUND(m.meb_bal - m.mab_bal,2) AS diff FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.product_type = 'SA' AND m.meb_bal > m.mab_bal ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Count accounts per criteria value that were opened before 2010.
details.sql: SELECT criteria, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE account_open_date < '2010-01-01' GROUP BY criteria ORDER BY accounts DESC, criteria

details.question: Which employee codes have more than 150 accounts in the MAB/MEB table?
details.sql: SELECT EMP_CODE, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY EMP_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 150 ORDER BY accounts DESC, EMP_CODE

details.question: Total MAB by balance bucket and retail/bulk flag.
details.sql: SELECT bal_bucket, retail_bulk, ROUND(SUM(mab_bal),2) AS total_mab FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY bal_bucket, retail_bulk ORDER BY bal_bucket, retail_bulk

details.question: List customers with a relationship manager managed profile and MAB above 100000, top 10.
details.sql: SELECT CUST_NAME, ACCTNO, mab_bal, MANAGED_EMPID FROM workspace.default.mab_meb WHERE managed_profile = 'RELATIONSHIP MANAGER' AND mab_bal > 100000 ORDER BY mab_bal DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: For each customer constellation code in P2C, show account count and total MAB.
details.sql: SELECT p.cust_const, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(SUM(m.mab_bal),2) AS total_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY p.cust_const ORDER BY total_mab DESC

details.question: How many open accounts have no card block code?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_no_block FROM workspace.default.p2c WHERE account_close_date = '-' AND card_block_code IS NULL

details.question: List the top 10 FD accounts with an original FD amount whose MAB is above the average MAB of all accounts that have an original FD amount.
details.sql: SELECT p.ucic_value, p.full_name, m.mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.product_type = 'FD' AND m.orig_fdamt IS NOT NULL AND m.mab_bal > (SELECT AVG(mab_bal) FROM workspace.default.mab_meb WHERE orig_fdamt IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Show accounts opened per year with a running cumulative total.
details.sql: SELECT yr, accounts_opened, SUM(accounts_opened) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS cumulative FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4)) t ORDER BY yr

details.question: For each product type show total accounts, closed accounts, closure percentage and total MAB, sorted by closure rate.
details.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT p.product_type, p.account_close_date, m.mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO), t AS (SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN account_close_date <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, SUM(mab_bal) AS tot_mab FROM j GROUP BY product_type) SELECT product_type, total, closed, ROUND(100.0 * closed / total, 2) AS closure_pct, ROUND(tot_mab,2) AS total_mab FROM t ORDER BY closure_pct DESC

details.question: For each product type among open accounts, which two employee codes hold the highest total MAB?
details.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT p.product_type, m.EMP_CODE, SUM(m.mab_bal) AS tot_mab, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_type ORDER BY SUM(m.mab_bal) DESC) AS rn FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' GROUP BY p.product_type, m.EMP_CODE) SELECT product_type, EMP_CODE, ROUND(tot_mab,2) AS tot_mab FROM x WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY product_type, rn

details.question: Find customers by name with open accounts in at least 3 different product types and total MAB above 50000. Top 10.
details.sql: SELECT p.full_name, COUNT(*) AS accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_type) AS products, ROUND(SUM(m.mab_bal),2) AS total_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' GROUP BY p.full_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_type) >= 3 AND SUM(m.mab_bal) > 50000 ORDER BY total_mab DESC, p.full_name LIMIT 10

details.question: Rank accounts by MAB within each product type and show the top 3 per product type.
details.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.product_type, p.source_account_nbr, p.full_name, m.mab_bal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_type ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC) AS rnk FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO) t WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY product_type, rnk

details.question: Show each product type's share of total MAB as a percentage.
details.sql: SELECT p.product_type, ROUND(SUM(m.mab_bal),2) AS total_mab, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.mab_bal) / SUM(SUM(m.mab_bal)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC

details.question: Which accounts have MAB above the average MAB of their own product type? Show the count per product type.
details.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.product_type, m.mab_bal, AVG(m.mab_bal) OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_type) AS avg_pt FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO) SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS above_avg_accounts FROM a WHERE mab_bal > avg_pt GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY above_avg_accounts DESC, product_type

details.question: Year-over-year change in the number of accounts opened.
details.sql: WITH y AS (SELECT SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY SUBSTR(account_open_date,1,4)) SELECT yr, cnt, LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS prev_cnt, cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS yoy_change FROM y ORDER BY yr

details.question: For every employee code, show the percentage of their accounts that are closed.
details.sql: SELECT m.EMP_CODE, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.account_close_date <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.account_close_date <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS closed_pct FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY m.EMP_CODE ORDER BY closed_pct DESC

details.question: Find product types where the average MAB of NRI customers is higher than that of non-NRI customers.
details.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.product_type, AVG(CASE WHEN p.nri_status = 'Y' THEN m.mab_bal END) AS nri_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN p.nri_status = 'N' THEN m.mab_bal END) AS non_nri_avg FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY p.product_type) SELECT product_type, ROUND(nri_avg,2) AS nri_avg, ROUND(non_nri_avg,2) AS non_nri_avg FROM a WHERE nri_avg > non_nri_avg ORDER BY product_type

details.question: Customers (by name) whose accounts span more than one source system, with the number of systems.
details.sql: Not under my knowledge.

details.question: Per GL description, how many accounts have MAB above the overall average MAB and how many are at or below it?
details.sql: SELECT gldesc, SUM(CASE WHEN mab_bal > (SELECT AVG(mab_bal) FROM workspace.default.mab_meb) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_avg, SUM(CASE WHEN mab_bal <= (SELECT AVG(mab_bal) FROM workspace.default.mab_meb) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_or_below_avg FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY gldesc ORDER BY gldesc

details.question: Accounts open for more than 10 years as of 2026-08-31 with MAB above 100000.
details.sql: SELECT p.source_account_nbr, p.full_name, p.account_open_date, m.mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' AND p.account_open_date < '2016-08-31' AND m.mab_bal > 100000 ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 15

details.question: Average account tenure in years (as of 2026-08-31) for open accounts by product type.
details.sql: SELECT p.product_type, COUNT(*) AS open_accounts, ROUND(AVG(datediff(to_date('2026-08-31'), to_date(p.account_open_date)) / 365.25),2) AS avg_tenure_yrs FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date = '-' GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY avg_tenure_yrs DESC

details.question: Closed accounts that still show a non-trivial balance: MAB above 50000, with months between open and close.
details.sql: SELECT p.source_account_nbr, p.product_type, p.account_open_date, p.account_close_date, ROUND(datediff(to_date(p.account_close_date), to_date(p.account_open_date)) / 30.44,1) AS months_open, ROUND(m.mab_bal,2) AS mab_bal FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.account_close_date <> '-' AND m.mab_bal > 50000 ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC LIMIT 15

details.question: For each income segment, the product type with the highest total MAB.
details.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.income_segment, p.product_type, SUM(m.mab_bal) AS tot, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.income_segment ORDER BY SUM(m.mab_bal) DESC) AS rn FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.income_segment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.income_segment, p.product_type) SELECT income_segment, product_type, ROUND(tot,2) AS total_mab FROM s WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY income_segment

details.question: Employee codes whose total MAB is above the average of per-employee total MAB.
details.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT EMP_CODE, SUM(mab_bal) AS tot FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY EMP_CODE) SELECT EMP_CODE, ROUND(tot,2) AS total_mab FROM e WHERE tot > (SELECT AVG(tot) FROM e) ORDER BY tot DESC

details.question: How many accounts have a different NRI flag in P2C and in the MAB/MEB table?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO WHERE p.nri_status <> m.nriflag

details.question: Per product type, the account with the maximum MAB, with customer name.
details.sql: SELECT product_type, source_account_nbr, full_name, ROUND(mab_bal,2) AS mab_bal FROM (SELECT p.product_type, p.source_account_nbr, p.full_name, m.mab_bal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_type ORDER BY m.mab_bal DESC) AS rn FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY product_type

details.question: Share of non-active accounts (dormancy status other than A) by product type, only where the share exceeds 25%.
details.sql: SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN dormancy_status <> 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_active, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dormancy_status <> 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_active_pct FROM workspace.default.p2c GROUP BY product_type HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dormancy_status <> 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 25 ORDER BY non_active_pct DESC

details.question: What is the smallest number of top accounts that together make up 50% of total MAB?
details.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT mab_bal, SUM(mab_bal) OVER (ORDER BY mab_bal DESC) AS running, SUM(mab_bal) OVER () AS total FROM workspace.default.mab_meb) SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_for_half_of_mab FROM r WHERE running - mab_bal < 0.5 * total

details.question: Employees (EMP_CODE) with both RETAIL and BULK accounts, showing the MAB split between them.
details.sql: SELECT EMP_CODE, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN retail_bulk = 'RETAIL' THEN mab_bal ELSE 0 END),2) AS retail_mab, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN retail_bulk = 'BULK' THEN mab_bal ELSE 0 END),2) AS bulk_mab FROM workspace.default.mab_meb GROUP BY EMP_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT retail_bulk) = 2 ORDER BY EMP_CODE

details.question: Accounts whose MAB is in the top 5% overall, counted by product type and open/closed status.
details.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.source_account_nbr, p.product_type, CASE WHEN p.account_close_date = '-' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS status, m.mab_bal, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.mab_bal) AS pr FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO) SELECT product_type, status, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM r WHERE pr >= 0.95 GROUP BY product_type, status ORDER BY product_type, status

details.question: Compare linked and not-linked accounts: for each product type show account counts and average MAB for each group.
details.sql: SELECT p.product_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.linked_userid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_accounts, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.linked_userid IS NOT NULL THEN m.mab_bal END),2) AS linked_avg_mab, SUM(CASE WHEN p.linked_userid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_linked_accounts, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.linked_userid IS NULL THEN m.mab_bal END),2) AS not_linked_avg_mab FROM workspace.default.p2c p JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY p.product_type
